import pandas as pd
files={'DL':'airlines/DL.csv','AA':'airlines/AA.csv','UA':'airlines/UA.csv'}
fl=pd.concat([pd.read_csv(p).assign(carrier=c) for c,p in files.items()], ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(fl),'unique ids',fl.flight_id.nunique(),'duplicate rows',fl.duplicated().sum(),'duplicate ids',fl.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
# check duplicate IDs differing
print(fl[fl.flight_id.duplicated(False)].sort_values('flight_id').to_string(index=False) if fl.flight_id.duplicated().any() else 'no dup ids')
# dedupe exact/ID, then calculate local date-time difference naturally handles midnight
fl=fl.drop_duplicates(subset=['flight_id']).copy()
fl['date_dt']=pd.to_datetime(fl['date'])
fl['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(fl['date']+' '+fl['sched_dep'])
fl['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(fl['date']+' '+fl['actual_dep'], errors='coerce')
# For actual clock after midnight, parsed same date gives negative; adjust if actual clock less sched clock
mask=fl['actual_dt'].notna() & (fl['actual_dt']<fl['sched_dt'])
fl.loc[mask,'actual_dt'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
fl['delay_min']=(fl.actual_dt-fl.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
# delayed completed only
x=fl[(~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay_min>15)].copy()
print('all rows/dedup',len(fl),'cancelled',fl.cancelled.sum(),'completed',(~fl.cancelled).sum(),'delayed',len(x),'delay range',fl.delay_min.min(),fl.delay_min.max())
wx=pd.read_csv('weather.csv')
print('weather duplicate keys',wx.duplicated(['airport','date','hour']).sum(), 'rows',len(wx))
wx['bad_weather']=wx.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA']) | ((wx.wx_code=='FG') & (wx.visibility_mi<1.0))
x['hour']=x.sched_dep.str[:2].astype(int)
x=x.merge(wx[['airport','date','hour','wx_code','visibility_mi','bad_weather']],left_on=['origin','date','hour'],right_on=['airport','date','hour'],how='left',indicator=True)
print('delayed merged',len(x),'weather missing', (x._merge!='both').sum())
print(x[['flight_id','carrier','origin','date','sched_dep','delay_min','wx_code','visibility_mi','bad_weather','_merge']].to_string(index=False))
print('bad count',x.bad_weather.sum(),'denom',len(x),'pct',100*x.bad_weather.mean())

files={'DL':'airlines/DL.csv','AA':'airlines/AA.csv','UA':'airlines/UA.csv'}
fl=pd.concat([pd.read_csv(p).assign(carrier=c) for c,p in files.items()],ignore_index=True)
fl['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(fl.date+' '+fl.sched_dep)
fl['actual_dt0']=pd.to_datetime(fl.date+' '+fl.actual_dep,errors='coerce')
fl['raw_min']=(fl.actual_dt0-fl.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
print('negative raw by ranges',fl.loc[fl.raw_min<0,['flight_id','date','sched_dep','actual_dep','raw_min','cancelled']].sort_values('raw_min').to_string(index=False))
# overnight only large negative; same-day early remains negative
fl['actual_dt']=fl.actual_dt0 + pd.to_timedelta((fl.raw_min < -15).astype(int),unit='D')
fl['delay_min']=(fl.actual_dt-fl.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
x=fl[(~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay_min>15)].copy(); x['hour']=x.sched_dep.str[:2].astype(int)
wx=pd.read_csv('weather.csv'); wx['bad_weather']=wx.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA'])|((wx.wx_code=='FG')&(wx.visibility_mi<1))
x=x.merge(wx[['airport','date','hour','bad_weather']],left_on=['origin','date','hour'],right_on=['airport','date','hour'],how='left')
print('counts',len(fl), 'completed',(~fl.cancelled).sum(),'delayed',len(x),'bad',x.bad_weather.sum(),'pct',round(100*x.bad_weather.mean(),10),'missing',x.bad_weather.isna().sum())
print('delays by carrier',x.groupby('carrier').agg(delayed=('flight_id','size'),bad=('bad_weather','sum')))
print('overnight delayed',((fl.delay_min>15)&(fl.raw_min<-15)).sum())

# Clock times earlier by >15 minutes indicate documented next-day delayed departure; ordinary early departures are retained negative.
a=a+pd.to_timedelta((raw < -15).astype(int),unit='D'); fl['delay']=(a-fl.s).dt.total_seconds()/60

fs['sched_m']=mins(fs.sched_dep); fs['actual_m']=mins(fs.actual_dep.fillna('00:00')); fs['raw']=fs.actual_m-fs.sched_m
print(fs.loc[(~fs.cancelled)&(fs.raw<0),['flight_id','date','origin','sched_dep','actual_dep','raw']].to_string(index=False))

f['sm']=mm(f.sched_dep); f['am']=mm(f.actual_dep.fillna('00:00')); f['delay']=f.am-f.sm

import pandas as pd
files={'DL':'airlines/DL.csv','AA':'airlines/AA.csv','UA':'airlines/UA.csv'}
fl=pd.concat([pd.read_csv(p).assign(carrier=c) for c,p in files.items()],ignore_index=True)
fl['date']=pd.to_datetime(fl['date'])
# inspect uniqueness / cancellation actuals
print('flights',len(fl),'unique ids',fl.flight_id.nunique(),'dupes',fl.flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'cancelled',fl.cancelled.sum(),'missing actual noncancel',fl.loc[~fl.cancelled,'actual_dep'].isna().sum())
# elapsed minute values using date + times; actual can next day
sched=pd.to_datetime(fl['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+fl.sched_dep)
actual=pd.to_datetime(fl['date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+fl.actual_dep,errors='coerce')
# if actual earlier clock than sched, add day (including cancellations nan)
fl['delay_min']=(actual-sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
fl.loc[(~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay_min<0),'delay_min'] += 1440
# But early departures negative should remain negative! correction wrongly turns early into +. Need identify actual clock less could be early vs overnight. documentation delayed may after midnight; infer if raw negative, likely early unless huge? dataset patterns. inspect negatives.
raw=(actual-sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
print('raw min/max',raw.min(),raw.max(),'raw negatives noncancel',raw[(~fl.cancelled)&(raw<0)].describe().to_dict())
print(fl.loc[(~fl.cancelled)&(raw<0),['date','sched_dep','actual_dep','delay_min']].head(20).to_string(index=False))

# Continue existing vars
# classify overnight clock rollover for large negative raw gaps; early departures are modest negatives
fl['delay_min']=raw
fl.loc[fl.delay_min < -60,'delay_min'] += 1440
print('delay stats',fl.loc[~fl.cancelled,'delay_min'].describe().to_dict(),'delayed',((~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay_min>15)).sum())
print('negative adjusted',fl.loc[(~fl.cancelled)&(fl.delay_min<0),'delay_min'].describe().to_dict())
w=pd.read_csv('weather.csv')
print('weather duplicate keys',w.duplicated(['airport','date','hour']).sum(),'rows',len(w),'airports',w.airport.nunique(),'dates',w.date.nunique())
# merge all flights with weather based scheduled local date/hour
fl['hour']=fl.sched_dep.str[:2].astype(int)
w['date']=pd.to_datetime(w.date)
fl2=fl.merge(w,left_on=['origin','date','hour'],right_on=['airport','date','hour'],how='left',indicator=True)
print('weather merge',fl2._merge.value_counts().to_dict(),'weather duplicates impact',len(fl2)-len(fl))
delayed=fl2[(~fl2.cancelled)&(fl2.delay_min>15)]
bad=delayed.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA']) | ((delayed.wx_code=='FG') & (delayed.visibility_mi<1.0))
print('delayed',len(delayed),'bad',bad.sum(),'pct',bad.mean()*100)
print(delayed.assign(bad=bad.values)[['carrier','date','origin','sched_dep','delay_min','wx_code','visibility_mi','bad']].to_string(index=False))

# sanity-check numerator/denominator by carrier and weather categories among delayed
x=delayed.copy(); x['bad']=x.wx_code.isin(['TS','SN','+RA']) | ((x.wx_code=='FG')&(x.visibility_mi<1))
print(x.groupby('carrier').agg(delayed=('flight_id','size'),bad=('bad','sum')).assign(pct=lambda z:100*z.bad/z.delayed))
print('codes delayed',x.wx_code.value_counts().to_dict())
print('cancelled by carrier',fl.groupby('carrier').cancelled.sum().to_dict())
print('all dates',fl.date.min(),fl.date.max(),'scheduled month counts',fl.date.dt.month.value_counts().to_dict())

issues.problem: The rollover rule is implemented as raw delay < -15 minutes. This incorrectly converts legitimate same-day early departures of more than 15 minutes into next-day departures and can inflate the delayed count. The notes claim ordinary early departures are retained, but the code does not do that.

The analyst does not show deduplication despite the documentation warning that the export may contain repeated records. Repeated flight rows would affect both the delayed-flight denominator and numerator.

The method uses a -60-minute heuristic to identify next-day departures. This is more defensible than S1's -15-minute rule, but it is still not explicitly justified from the data/documentation; rollover should be based on the dataset's identifiable overnight cases while preserving ordinary early departures.
The concatenated flight data are not deduplicated after checking for duplicate flight IDs, despite the documented possibility of repeated records.

The initial delay calculation adds 1,440 minutes to every negative raw delay, which is explicitly wrong for early departures. Although the later code overwrites it with a < -60-minute rule, the final method still relies on an undocumented heuristic.

The flight records are not demonstrably deduplicated. The code checks duplicate counts but does not remove repeated flight records, so the reported 246/76 counts could be affected if duplicates are present.

critique.disagreements: All three analysts report 246 delayed flights and 76 bad-weather delayed flights, yielding 30.9%. S1 classifies any clock difference below -15 minutes as an overnight rollover, whereas S2 and S3 use a -60-minute cutoff. S1's rule conflicts with the requirement to retain ordinary early departures as negative delays. S3 also contains an initially incorrect rollover calculation but subsequently replaces it with the -60-minute rule. None clearly handles repeated flight records as required by the data documentation.
critique.correction: Use the result 30.9% only after deduplicating flight records and applying a validated overnight-rollover rule that does not convert ordinary early departures. The final JSON should be {"pct_in_bad_weather":30.9} if deduplication and the validated rollover handling leave the reported 76/246 counts unchanged.
